intermediate_failed_run.boundary: Both privacy component jobs passed, but the whole interim run failed the retained menu count assertion. Its component success is not reused as final release acceptance.

corrections.problem: The retained campaign-click fixture expected measurement without the required explicit browser choice and expected the pre-normalization installation-prefixed path.
corrections.change: Prove the unconsented acknowledgement leaves marketing bytes unchanged, save consent using the real privacy form, verify installation-scoped cookies and no event from choice alone, then require exactly one consented click at canonical /campaign/.

intermediate_attempt.description: Root cases passed; the new cookie inspection initially used the bare nested base. Inspecting base plus trailing slash corrected the fixture without a runtime change.

first_failure.description: The generic text-control width >=20 check rejected an 18x18 native enabled checkbox already inside its 44px-high label.

subsequent_negative_control.description: Measuring the real label exposed the queue checkbox without the existing marketing-check class: 13px-high indicator and 41px-high label.

corrections.change: Add class="marketing-check" to the existing queue checkbox label. The fixture measures indicator containment and a >=44px associated target, clicks the label and restores the state with keyboard Space across four browser cases.

corrections.observed_failure: Menu rendering removed fixed credit/legal links.
corrections.diagnosis: The retained fixture had two count==5 assumptions; the current fixed footer has six links including Privacy choices.
corrections.change: Replace two obsolete count-of-five assertions with the exact six ordered labels and installation-scoped destinations, plus fixed credit label/href/new-tab safety. Existing navigation, access, layout and unrelated-state preservation gates retained.

known_mobile_visibility_failure.consequence: All six links exist in the DOM, but are hidden from phone users, including Privacy choices.
known_mobile_visibility_failure.publication_behavior: Policy destinations are checked exactly. Unpublished policy pages are not asserted to return 200; real publication remains an owner-reviewed runtime action.

corrections.boundary: These four passing semantic cases retain the actual observed hidden-mobile defect. The separate mobile runtime correction requires its own real browser proof below.

corrections.problem: The existing max-width:760px rule hid all six fixed legal links, including Privacy choices, from phone users even though DOM destinations were correct.

subsequent_failed_menu_run.assertion: The saved custom footer leaves its independent credit under the player.
subsequent_failed_menu_run.diagnosis_status: Actual wheel reached the available document end and exposed the credit above the player. The prior if-needed scroll stopped early. The same runtime passed both focused actual Tab traversals; this clearance failure is corrected in the fixture without another CSS change.

corrections.boundary: Verification covers visible links, geometry, pointer clicks and touchscreen Privacy choices taps, with existing menu keyboard gates retained. The focused native diagnostic separately exercises Privacy choices and credit with Tab; a complete legal-link Tab-order audit across every case is not claimed.

final_focused_acceptance.publication_behavior: Fresh policies remain unpublished. Actual policy clicks must return the precise unpublished 404 page; Privacy choices must return 200 with real controls and measurement off. No legal text is manufactured or published by the fixture.

corrections.change: Require all six legal links to be visible at every tested width, preserving geometry, compactness, player, fixed-credit and scene gates.
corrections.negative_control_scope: New footer requirement evaluated against retained actual-browser measurements from the old frozen runtime; no new browser run is claimed. Twelve phone measurements reject the previously hidden legal links; twelve larger-width measurements retain their pass.

visual_review_by_parent.findings: At 320px, all six legal/privacy links wrap into two rows with the credit below; no clipping or overlap. At 1440px, the compact horizontal layout and blue underlined new-tab credit remain readable.

corrections.retained_gates: Actual uploads, Save/Preview/Publish/reload, Hero/Footer device geometry and pixels, all viewport comparisons, compact intrinsic footer height, font minima, within-footer bounds and no overlap, player clearance, real safe new-tab credit navigation, and empty-catalogue clearance are preserved.
